lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A primary cluster of high-intensity circular maxima is visible posterior to the gills, organized into roughly vertical columns. The most prominent columns contain four distinct nodes each, forming a repeating grid across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of diffuse, elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting the primary horizontal rows of circular blobs to form a grid of anchor nodes, particularly distinct in the first two columns behind the gill slits.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant horizontal linear feature is visible across the upper third of the flank, defined by a distinct luminance gradient with high intensity on the dorsal side and shadow-casting on the ventral side.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A reddish-pink discoloration/lesion is visible superior to the first and second gill slits; a secondary smaller red pixel cluster is visible on the mid-flank between the second and third spot columns.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin, visible in the lower-left quadrant, exhibits a high spatial density of micro-spots that are significantly smaller and more numerous than the macro-spots on the lateral flank.
